header.reserved_policy: zero only at explicit initialization; preserve when loaded

reserved_tail.policy: unallocated, zero at initialization, preserve during unrelated edits

transaction_selection.required: both native block CRCs and footer schemas valid, supported campaign header, equal native counters
transaction_selection.selection: newest complete pair using native SaveCounterCompare; equal valid counters choose partition 0
transaction_selection.rollover: 0 is newer than 4294967295; otherwise unsigned comparison
transaction_selection.incomplete_partition_policy: retain its original bytes; never merge its newer general data with another partition's PC data

scope: Primary persistent donor flag/variable namespaces, not a complete port of every donor save subsystem.
unsupported_policy: Refuse unsupported tagged versions and incompatible legacy files in an activated native build; do not silently initialize or overwrite them. Editor forks retain their separate vanilla parsing path.
migration_policy: Never automatic or in-place. A separately requested migration must preserve existing gameplay records and initialize only the new allocation; it must not invent campaign progress.
